newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices steady amid thin buying.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices steady amid thin buying.

text.p: Energy futures prices on NYMEX ACCESS were steady to lower Thursday, as overnight buyers waited on the sidelines to see how much farther the U.S. market would fall.
"(Traders) are waiting to find out what kind of gasoline demand and production is coming over the next couple weeks," one trader said.
Increasing crude supplies and growing imports pushed futures prices down sharply yesterday, with gasoline off 3.3 percent to 60.61 cents a gallon.
But NYMEX energy futures were stable Thursday, with crude for May delivery unchanged at $19.47 a barrel.
In overnight trade, NYMEX May crude trimmed three cents a barrel from the settle to trade $19.44. About 1,100 lots traded overall and 700 in the front month.
NYMEX May heating oil fell 0.21 cents from the market close of 53.26, with amid total volume at 100 lots, and 40 lots traded in May, traders said.
Front month gasoline was sold at 60.90 cents, flat from end of floor trade, as a thin 16 lots traded in May and 50 overall.
